overview.description: The WisdomTree Efficient TIPS Plus Gold Fund (GDT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is an actively managed ETF that provides exposure to US Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities and US-listed gold futures. The fund seeks total return by maintaining approximately balanced exposure to inflation-linked Treasuries and gold, using derivatives to enhance capital efficiency GDT was launched on Jan 22, 2026 and is issued by WisdomTree.
